description: One release, and everything the record holds about it.

carried.description: The version whose goals this tag carried, where that is not its own.

delivers.description: What it set out to deliver, in the words the version was staged under.

groups.description: The changes, gathered by what kind of change each is.

patches.description: The version this one patched, where it is a patch.

released_on.description: The day it was published, where the record of it says.

tag.description: The tag it was cut from.

user_facing.description: Whether anything in it is a change an operator would notice.

version.description: The version, without the tag's leading letter.

withdrawn.description: Why it was withdrawn, where it was.
